body:
Problem:
on_complete_done() defers clear_word() and the snippet expansion until completionItem/resolve answers, and drops both when 'changedtick' moved meanwhile. Typing right after accepting leaves the plain word in the buffer.

Solution:
Expand before requesting, and anchor the resolved edits with an extmark instead of gating them on 'changedtick'.

comment_data.body:
We can just set `has_edits` to its correct value directly and reference it in the if statement below.
```suggestion
  local has_edits = edits and next(edits)
  if has_edits then
```

comment_data.body:
`lsp.util` is a bit of mess so adding this is fine, it keeps `lsp.completion` more focused, and avoids repeating this logic in other places.

I was hoping that we could followup and potentially drop this new `opts.keep_cursor` after https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/41789 is resolved, but that seems to be the inverse. We might actually want  `vim._with({ keepcursor` , analogous to `keepcwd`: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/67a8407dbab0c065e0a220d31438951fbac4cb06/test/functional/lua/with_spec.lua#L425
comment_data.diff_hunk:
@@ -2961,6 +2961,10 @@ apply_text_edits({text_edits}, {bufnr}, {position_encoding},
       • {bufnr}               (`integer`) Buffer id
       • {position_encoding}   (`'utf-8'|'utf-16'|'utf-32'`)
       • {change_annotations}  (`table<string, lsp.ChangeAnnotation>?`)
+      • {opts}                (`table?`) A table with the following fields:
+                              • {keep_cursor}? (`boolean`, default: `false`)
